narrative.narrative: Exchanges shed 170.8 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.0637 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, a reversal from a 716.9 million dollar intake at 0.2667 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a negative print means money left the place where holders can sell, and the sign change means that arrival has turned into a departure. Binance went from taking in 685.2 million dollars to shedding 51.1 million, Bitfinex's outflow widened to 262.4 million dollars from 231.1 million, Bybit shed 105.0 million, and Bitstamp still took in 409.7 million.
